items.q: Painful flaccid oral erosions precede fragile skin blisters that rupture with lateral pressure. The split level is?
items.exp: Pemphigus vulgaris splits just above basal cells leaving tombstone basals, starting in the mouth with anti-desmoglein antibodies.
r: Incorrect. That gives tense blisters without oral start.
Incorrect. That is staphylococcal in children.
Incorrect. That gives target lesions.
Correct. Suprabasal acantholysis with oral onset.
items.kp: Oral flaccid blisters mean suprabasal pemphigus.

items.q: Pressing on a blister edge extends it into normal skin. This bulla-spread sign with a positive Nikolsky indicates?
items.exp: Asboe-Hansen bulla spread plus Nikolsky marks ongoing intraepidermal acantholysis of active pemphigus.
r: Incorrect. Friction blisters do not spread this way.
Incorrect. Those are tense and non-spreading.
Correct. Extending blister in active disease.
Incorrect. Burns lack autoimmune acantholysis.
items.kp: Spreading blister edge means active pemphigus.

items.q: An elderly patient has tense itchy blisters on flexures and thighs without mucosal lesions. The likely disease and target are?
o: Bullous pemphigoid against hemidesmosome BP180 and BP230
items.exp: Bullous pemphigoid is a subepidermal tense-blister disease of the elderly at flexures with linear BMZ IgG.
r: Incorrect. That strings pearls in children.
Correct. Tense elderly blisters are pemphigoid.
Incorrect. That gives flaccid oral-start blisters.
Incorrect. That gives itchy extensor papulovesicles.

items.q: Fishnet IgG between keratinocytes on direct immunofluorescence indicates?
items.exp: Intercellular net-like IgG marks pemphigus antibodies; linear BMZ band marks pemphigoid; granular papillary IgA marks dermatitis herpetiformis.
r: Correct. Fishnet intercellular IgG.
Incorrect. That gives a linear BMZ band.
Incorrect. That gives granular papillary IgA.
Incorrect. That shows vessel-wall deposits.

items.q: Intensely itchy grouped vesicles on elbows, knees and buttocks with malabsorption suggest?
items.exp: Dermatitis herpetiformis is the extensor papulovesicular rash of coeliac disease with granular IgA at dermal papillae.
r: Incorrect. That burrows webs with nocturnal itch.
Incorrect. That gives large tense blisters.
Incorrect. That punches out herpetic erosions.
Correct. Itchy extensor vesicles with gluten link.
items.kp: Itchy extensor vesicles mean dermatitis herpetiformis.

items.q: A child has annular rings of tense blisters like a string of pearls around the mouth and genitalia. This is?
items.exp: Linear IgA disease strings tense blisters in rosettes in children with linear BMZ IgA.
r: Incorrect. That gives acral targets.
Incorrect. That adds mouth ulcers with limb vesicles.
Correct. String-of-pearls in a child.
Incorrect. That gives honey crusts.
items.kp: Pearl-string blisters in a child mean linear IgA.

items.q: Scaly crusted erosions on the face and chest without mucosal disease in an older adult suggest?
items.exp: Pemphigus foliaceus splits superficially in seborrhoeic areas without mucosal involvement, with anti-desmoglein-1.
r: Incorrect. That lacks acantholysis.
Correct. Seborrhoeic crusts without mucosal disease.
Incorrect. That starts with oral erosions.
Incorrect. That gives tense blisters.
items.kp: Seborrhoeic crusts without mouth disease mean foliaceus.

items.q: Refractory stomatitis with lichenoid skin lesions in a patient with lymphoma suggests?
items.exp: Paraneoplastic pemphigus pairs severe stomatitis with polymorphic skin lesions and anti-plakin antibodies in lymphoid neoplasia.
r: Correct. Stomatitis plus neoplasm.
Incorrect. That follows transplantation.
Incorrect. That lacks neoplasm association.
Incorrect. That follows herpes or drugs acutely.
items.kp: Stomatitis with lymphoma means paraneoplastic pemphigus.

items.q: Backbone therapy for severe pemphigus with steroid-sparing support uses?
o: Systemic corticosteroids with agents like azathioprine, mycophenolate or rituximab classes
items.exp: Severe pemphigus needs systemic steroids bridged to steroid-sparing immunosuppressants or B-cell therapy with infection cover.
r: Incorrect. Antibiotics only cover superinfection.
Incorrect. Topicals cannot control severe disease.
Incorrect. Fungi are not involved.
Correct. Steroid backbone plus sparing classes.
items.kp: Severe pemphigus needs systemic plus sparing therapy.

items.q: Neonatal blistering with widespread peeling but spared mucosae in a nursery cluster favours scalded skin over pemphigus because?
o: It shows fishnet IgG on DIF
It shows superficial split without autoantibodies and links to staphylococcal carriers
items.exp: Scalded skin is toxin-mediated superficial peeling without antibodies, tracing to nasal carriers, unlike autoimmune pemphigus.
r: Incorrect. Fishnet IgG marks pemphigus.
Incorrect. Mucosae are spared in scalded skin.
Correct. Toxin peel without antibodies.
Incorrect. Tombstoning marks pemphigus.
items.kp: Nursery peeling without antibodies is scalded skin.
